sources.fullCitation: Orkiestra teatru „Perskie Oko”, conducted by Zygmunt Wiehler. “A zresztą… niech pan zadzwoni.” Shimmy. Syrena Grand Record 17921, matrix 17921, 1926. Transfer published by Stare Melodie from a privately held disc.
sources.title: A zresztą… niech pan zadzwoni — Syrena Grand Record 17921

sources.researchNote: The upload description credits the music to Henryk Chwast under the pseudonym Bruno Asper. The attribution is resolved to Bronisław Kaper because both forms are independently documented as his pseudonyms.

sources.fullCitation: “Zgaś lampę!” Shimmy. YouTube audio reference published by jurek46pink; the upload identifies Henryk Gold and his ensemble.
sources.title: Zgaś lampę! — Henryk Gold ensemble, YouTube
sources.creator: Henryk Gold and his ensemble
sources.researchNote: The upload description dates the recording to 1926, identifies Henryk Gold and his ensemble in an acoustically recorded instrumental Syrena version and associates the composition with the name Bruno Asper. No label, catalogue or matrix number is supplied and the disc is not shown. The year and recording details remain uploader-supplied; the printed sheet music documents the composition, not this recording or its carrier.

sources.fullCitation: Orkiestra taneczna. “San Francisco.” Foxtrot. Digital transfer on YouTube; the upload identifies Syrena Record, gives the year as 1937 and credits Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann with music and Emanuel Schlechter with Polish words.
sources.title: San Francisco — Polish-language recording, YouTube
sources.creator: Orkiestra taneczna
sources.researchNote: The upload identifies an unnamed dance orchestra and a Syrena Record issue, gives the year as 1937 and attributes the Polish words to Emanuel Schlechter. It supplies no catalogue or matrix number, does not show the disc label and does not distinguish recording from issue year. These details remain uploader-supplied, not a verified description of a historical pressing.

sources.shortCitation: Stare Melodie, “O tym już wróble świergocą na dachu” — Syrena-Electro 3461 (1930)
sources.fullCitation: Stare Melodie. “O tym już wróble świergocą na dachu.” Tadeusz Faliszewski with the orchestra of Towarzystwo Syrena Record; recording dated March 1930 in the listening-entry metadata. Syrena-Electro 3461, matrix 20876.
sources.title: O tym już wróble świergocą na dachu — Syrena-Electro 3461
sources.creator: Stare Melodie
sources.researchNote: The Stare Melodie listening entry dates the recording to March 1930. An embedded YouTube title instead gives 1929; the site’s editor explicitly corrects that year to March 1930 in the comments. The structured date follows the site’s catalogue entry and identifies the recording, not a separately established issue date.
